summary: Phase 5b: backward proof infrastructure built. backward_2var_nf_agreement, nf_exist_formula_nested_backward (sorry), nf_composition_depth0 added. Master induction wired to backward theorem. Formula insufficiency confirmed: char_k gives 1-var NF but 3-var NF needs 2-var composition. Fix: use char_{k+1} for interval witnesses. Pre-existing compat helper regression (Lean version change).

blockers.description: Formula nf_exist_formula_nested uses char_k (depth-k 1-var NF) for interval witnesses, but the backward direction needs the depth-k 3-var NF at (y,x,t), which requires depth-k 2-var NFs of (y,x) and (y,t) via composition. char_k does NOT determine these 2-var NFs at depth >= 1. Recommended fix: change char_k to char_{k+1} in interval witness conditions (the depth-(k+1) 1-var NF of y records all depth-k 2-var NFs at (z,y)), then use composition lemma to bridge.
